report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with HIV a few months ago, started Biktarvy four weeks ago. HIV symptoms have mostly resolved. Reports feeling overwhelmed, mild anxiety, and difficulty sleeping, which they attribute to knowing they have HIV. Experiences mild morning nausea from medication but it doesn't affect appetite or adherence. Adherence is excellent — takes medication every day as instructed. No recent blood work yet; expects undetectable viral load within 3-6 months. Views HIV as a lifelong condition to manage, with early treatment offering best long-term prognosis. Takes personal responsibility for health by following treatment plan and maintaining healthy lifestyle. Understands treatment goal (undetectable viral load) and what to monitor (viral load, CD4 count), but doesn't understand how medication works biologically. Trusts healthcare team to monitor and adjust treatment.
